title: HB1417 (2026 Regular): Public Safety - Handgun Permit Requirement - Repeal (Maryland Constitutional Carry Act)

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Maryland text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2026RS/bills/hb/hb1417f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader (as filed); no passage vote recorded. Bracketed text deleted from § 4–203(a)–(b) removes the permit-holder exemption and exemptions for transport to or from purchase or repair, gun collectors, carrying on one's own property or business, supervisory employees, and carrying under a surrender order; those are not quoted as the bill's acts.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety, Title 5, Subtitle 3): That Section(s) 5–301 and 5–303 through 5–314 and the subtitle “Subtitle 3. Handgun Permits” of Article – Public Safety of the Annotated Code of Maryland be repealed.
Section 2 (Md. Code Ann., Criminal Law § 4–203(a)(1)): (i) A PERSON UNDER THE AGE OF 21 YEARS MAY NOT wear, carry, or transport a handgun, whether concealed or open, on or about the person; (iii) A PERSON MAY NOT WEAR, CARRY, OR TRANSPORT A HANDGUN, WHETHER CONCEALED OR OPEN, ON OR ABOUT THE PERSON while on public school property in the State; (iv) A PERSON MAY NOT WEAR, CARRY, OR TRANSPORT A HANDGUN, WHETHER CONCEALED OR OPEN, ON OR ABOUT THE PERSON with the deliberate purpose of injuring or killing another person; (v) A PERSON UNDER THE AGE OF 21 YEARS MAY NOT WEAR, CARRY, OR TRANSPORT A HANDGUN, WHETHER CONCEALED OR OPEN, ON OR ABOUT THE PERSON with THE handgun loaded with ammunition.
Section 2 (Md. Code Ann., Criminal Law § 4–207): (A) A PERSON MAY NOT WEAR, CARRY, OR TRANSPORT A HANDGUN WHILE THE PERSON IS UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF ALCOHOL OR DRUGS. (B) A PERSON WHO VIOLATES THIS SECTION IS GUILTY OF A MISDEMEANOR AND ON CONVICTION IS SUBJECT TO IMPRISONMENT NOT EXCEEDING 1 YEAR OR A FINE NOT EXCEEDING $1,000 OR BOTH.
